Sam (Sales): Passing VelvetAI — post-sign kickoff. 10-seat pilot, HIPAA scope, wants private VPC + SSO + optional Dedicated GPU trial for burst. Renewal in ~9 months, finance flagged cost sensitivity.

Maria (CS): Received. Thanks Sam. I'll own onboarding. Quick Q: do we have install window and SSO type? Any initial test data access? :eyes:

Sam (Sales): SSO = SAML (Okta). Install window preferred next Tue 10-12 PST. They'll bring sample PHI-like test dataset (anonymized). Provisioning request: private VPC + 1 dedicated GPU node for 2 weeks. Sales notes attached: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8712

Maria (CS): Cool. Creating onboarding ticket and checklist. I'll assign tasks and link to the support queue. Creating ticket CS-67890 now.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-67890 created by Maria (CS). Template: "onboarding-private-vpc". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-67890

Maria (CS): Next steps — short checklist:
- Provision private VPC (net ops) - owner: Devon (EngOps) - due: 1717278400
- Add SAML config & test SSO - owner: Leo (Support) - due: 1717282000
- Spin dedicated GPU (2w) - owner: Devon (Eng) - due: 1717275000
- Upload anonymized test data & run smoke tests - owner: VelvetAI contact (TBD) & Maria - due: 1717285600
- Capture initial quality eval & cost estimate - owner: Maria - due: 1717289200

Devon (Eng): Noted. I'll handle VPC + GPU. Quick note: for the dedicated node we'll use the nvidia-a100-80gb-qa image. Provision command (infra):
```
rbw infra create --project velvetai --vpc private-velvet --gpu a100:1 --duration 14d --owner devon
```
I'll open infra ticket INFRA-4532 and link it to CS-67890.

Devon (Eng): Also flagging potential network egress rules for their EHR vendor. Might need a whitelisted CIDR. Will follow up in INFRA-4532.

Leo (Support): I'll own SAML config and run SSO test plan. If SSO fails we'll fallback to invite-only accounts for pilot. I'll add runbook steps to CS-67890. Also I'll monitor for any LLM latency regressions and open a perf ticket if p90 > 600ms.

Maria (CS): Owners confirmed. Risk flags:
- Renewal risk: medium (price sensitive). Add "renewal_watch" tag on the account.
- Data risk: high (PHI) — ensure KMS + audit logs enabled.
- Timeline: tight (provisioning + SSO before next Tue).

Sam (Sales): I'll schedule kickoff with the customer and include finance for cost expectations. Will also confirm the VelvetAI contact for test data.

Maria (CS): Capture feedback loop: we'll send short NPS pulse after pilot week 1 and 2. Also request a single canonical evaluation prompt set (Maria will provide template).

Devon (Eng): Linking INFRA-4532 -> CS-67890. If infra needs extra quota I'll request growth—pinging @cloud-quota.

Leo (Support): I'll subscribe support-oncall and enable longer log retention for first 30d.

Maria (CS): Great. Action owners: Maria (onboarding lead), Devon (infra + dedicated), Leo (SSO + support), Sam (customer comms). I'll post a final runbook in the ticket and update this thread once infra ticket lands. :thumbsup:

Sam (Sales): Thanks team. Quick ask — can we have a concise bullet list for exec summary for customer success review? Maria, can you draft and I'll share with customer leadership.

Maria (CS): On it. Will attach rundown to CS-67890 and ping here when ready.

ops-bot: CS-67890 linked to INFRA-4532 and support queue. Reminders set for due dates.

Leo (Support): :white_check_mark:

Devon (Eng): :shipit:

Maria (CS): Closing initial handoff. Will update last_message_ts once infra provisioned.
